description: This file defines a class `HTMLNode` as part of the Yahoo! UI library, specifically for representing HTML nodes within a TreeView widget. It includes methods for initializing content, generating HTML for the node, and interacting with the DOM.

classes.name: HTMLNode
classes.description: Represents an individual HTML node within a TreeView structure, capable of rendering its content and managing icon and expansion state.

methods.name: initContent(oData,hasIcon)
methods.description: Initializes the HTML content of the node, setting HTML data, icon presence, and content element ID.

methods.name: getContentEl()
methods.description: Returns the DOM element corresponding to this node's content.

methods.name: getNodeHtml()
methods.description: Generates the HTML string representing this node, including icons, indentation, and content.
